subject: Operator access dataset packaging & handover for compliance request
messages:
From: Audits Team <audits@medicosys.com>

Subject: Request: operator access log dataset + handover requirements (SOC 2 / SIG)

Hi Sean,

We're preparing our SIG / SOC 2 evidence bundle and need a packaged export of operator-level access and admin activity for the Redwood environment that MedicoSys uses. Can you provide: 

- A list of files you can produce (format + compressed size estimate)
- Field-level mapping (what columns/fields are included)
- Retention window for the source logs and any known sampling/truncation
- Recommended export method (S3 presigned URL vs. encrypted transfer) and chain-of-custody steps
- Any items that will be redacted or require a legal request

We'd like to ingest the bundle into our evidence repository by EOD 15 Oct. Please let us know if there are any blockers.

Thanks,
Laura Indigo
Lead IT Compliance, MedicoSys

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com; monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2025-10-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator access log dataset + handover requirements (SOC 2 / SIG)

Hi Laura / MedicoSys audits team,

Thanks — we can produce a self-contained evidence bundle for operator/admin activity. High level summary below; attachments: packaging-checklist.pdf (internal packaging playbook) and a manifest stub.

What we can deliver:
- File types: Parquet (columnar) + gzip, and NDJSON (line-delimited JSON) for ingestion compatibility.
- Typical bundle contents: operator-activity-YYYY-MM-DD.parquet.gz, operator-access-manifest.csv, checksums.sha256, packaging-checklist.pdf, signed-handoff-template.docx
- Field-level mapping (core fields): timestamp_utc, tenant_id, resource_type, resource_id, action, actor_type (user/service/operator), actor_id (internal user id), session_id, ip_address (redacted by default), request_payload_hash, result_code, kv_cache_change (if applicable), workload_tag

Retention / sampling:
- Source admin activity logs are retained for 12 months by default (365 days).
- Operator session ephemeral traces (e.g., interactive session transcripts) are retained 90 days and are not included in exports without a legal request; we can produce higher-fidelity artifacts on a case-by-case basis.
- Exports are not sampled — they are deterministic extracts for the time window requested. If export size is a concern we can provide a timebox (e.g., rolling 7d snapshots).

Export mechanics / chain of custody:
- Preferred delivery: encrypted archive uploaded to an S3 bucket we control, you pull via a presigned GET (7-day expiry) OR we push to a MedicoSys bucket via an AWS cross-account role/put object.
- All files will include SHA256 checksums in checksums.sha256; we also produce a signed manifest (packaging-checklist.pdf covers steps).
- We can PGP-encrypt archives on request and provide the public key exchange via DocuSign link.

Redaction / legal constraints:
- IP addresses and raw request payloads are redacted by default for hosted tenants; we can provide pseudo-anonymized actor_ids mapped to a stable internal id.
- Anything that contains customer data in payloads is excluded unless you provide a written acceptance (we'll route to legal).

Next steps / ETA:
- If you confirm the time window (start/end UTC) we'll kick off an extract job. Typical turnaround for a 30-day extract: 48–72 hours.
- Proposed handoff: Wed 2025-10-15 morning UTC.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
--

Laura / team — adding ops-side notes and the manifest stub. Couple of clarifications: 

- We will include an operator-access-manifest.csv that lists every file, row counts, size (uncompressed/compressed), and SHA256 checksums.
- For pinned/cloud-dedicated customers we can include the mapping from operator user_id => email for audited personnel; for hosted customers we provide role/actor_type only. Since MedicoSys is using a dedicated instance, we will include the operator email mapping (subject to a narrow data transfer agreement).
- Session recordings: we do not include full session video/TTY logs by default. Those are on a different retention schedule and require a signed request.

Packaging notes (quick):
1) Export window: please confirm UTC start/end (we assume 2025-09-01 to 2025-10-01 for an initial bundle).
2) Delivery method: confirm preference for S3 presigned GET or cross-account PUT.
3) Legal: if you want IP addresses preserved we require a signed acceptance (policy exception).

Attachments in this thread: operator-access-manifest.csv (stub) and the checklist. We'll include the signed-handoff-template.docx in the final bundle so you can acknowledge receipt.

Vanessa Ortiz
Technical Program Manager, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference
